headline_marked: Father [[kills two children by drowning them]] in Sunamganj haor
headline: Father kills two children by drowning them in Sunamganj haor
summary: The man allegedly gave the children sleeping pills before throwing them into the water to stage a disappearance.
details: A 30-year-old man named Kamrul Islam has been detained for allegedly killing his two children, Muhaddis (7) and Tulna (4), in Sunamganj.
Police recovered the bodies of the children from the water of the haor in separate locations within the Sunamganj and Shantiganj areas.
According to police, Kamrul confessed to the crime, stating he was distressed by frequent quarrels between his wife, Afroza Begum, and his mother, Fuljan Bibi, over the children's behavior.
The conflict escalated on a Friday morning when Kamrul's mother claimed she was assaulted by his wife. After a heated argument with his wife, Kamrul became enraged.
On Friday afternoon, he took the children and left home without informing anyone, traveling to Sylhet and staying there for two days.
While returning to Sunamganj on Sunday, he allegedly fed the children sleeping pills and threw Tulna into the haor in the Boro Kapon area of Shantiganj.
He then took Muhaddis to the Gobindpur area of Sunamganj Sadar and threw him into the water as well.
After returning home, Kamrul staged a disappearance by reporting the children missing to the police and posting on Facebook to seek help.
Dirai Police Station's OC Mo. Aminul Islam confirmed the arrest and stated that a case will be filed against the accused.
caption:
A father staged a missing person's report after drugging and drowning his own children to end family disputes.

A 30-year-old man named Kamrul Islam has been detained for allegedly killing his two children, Muhaddis (7) and Tulna (4), in Sunamganj.

Police recovered the bodies of the children from the water of the haor in separate locations within the Sunamganj and Shantiganj areas.

According to police, Kamrul confessed to the crime, stating he was distressed by frequent quarrels between his wife, Afroza Begum, and his mother, Fuljan Bibi, over the children's behavior.

The conflict escalated on a Friday morning when Kamrul's mother claimed she was assaulted by his wife. After a heated argument with his wife, Kamrul became enraged.

On Friday afternoon, he took the children and left home without informing anyone, traveling to Sylhet and staying there for two days.

While returning to Sunamganj on Sunday, he allegedly fed the children sleeping pills and threw Tulna into the haor in the Boro Kapon area of Shantiganj.

He then took Muhaddis to the Gobindpur area of Sunamganj Sadar and threw him into the water as well.

After returning home, Kamrul staged a disappearance by reporting the children missing to the police and posting on Facebook to seek help.

Dirai Police Station's OC Mo. Aminul Islam confirmed the arrest and stated that a case will be filed against the accused.

headline_marked: Powerful [[bomb in pressure cooker defused]] in Savar
headline: Powerful bomb in pressure cooker defused in Savar
summary: The device, wrapped in black tape, was found in an open field beside a mosque. A loud blast shook the neighborhood as the Bomb Disposal Unit neutralized it.
details: A powerful bomb hidden inside a pressure cooker wrapped in black tape was defused today in Savar. The device was discovered in an open field beside the Laltek Ghora Mosque.
Local residents had found the pressure cooker inside a blue plastic drum the previous night. They removed it from the drum and placed it on the field before alerting authorities.
Police arrived at the scene around 8:00 am today after receiving an emergency call. They immediately cordoned off the area and called in the Dhaka Metropolitan Police's (DMP) Bomb Disposal Unit.
The Bomb Disposal Unit arrived at 1:45 pm and ordered the evacuation of of the entire area for safety.
The device was successfully neutralized at 3:28 pm. A loud blast shook the neighborhood as the bomb was defused, triggering panic among local residents.
Savar Police Station Inspector (Investigation) Nur Mohammad stated that the bomb was very powerful and senior officials will provide further details on the matter.
